introduce.title: O que é o joymagic?
introduce.label: Introdução
introduce.description: joymagic é um modelo de base eficiente, com 6 bilhões de parâmetros, para geração de imagens. Com otimizações sistemáticas, ele mostra que é possível alcançar desempenho de ponta sem depender de modelos enormes, entregando ótimos resultados em geração fotorrealista e renderização de texto bilíngue.

items.title: Photorealistic Quality
items.description: Photography-level realism with fine control over details, lighting, and textures. Achieves excellent aesthetic quality in composition and overall mood.

items.title: Ultra-fast Inference
items.description: Achieves sub-second inference latency on enterprise-grade H800 GPUs. Only 8 steps needed for generation.

items.title: Bilingual Text Rendering
items.description: Accurate rendering of both Chinese and English text while preserving facial realism and overall aesthetic composition.

items.title: Efficient VRAM Usage
items.description: Can run smoothly on consumer-grade graphics cards with less than 16GB of VRAM, making advanced image generation accessible.

usage.title: Model Variants
usage.description: joymagic offers specialized models for different use cases:

items.title: 🚀 Z Image Turbo
items.description: A distilled version of joymagic with strong capabilities in photorealistic image generation, accurate rendering of both Chinese and English text, and robust adherence to bilingual instructions. It achieves performance comparable to or exceeding leading competitors with only 8 steps.

items.title: ✍️ joymagic Edit
items.description: A continued-training variant of joymagic specialized for image editing. It excels at following complex instructions to perform a wide range of tasks, from precise local modifications to global style transformations, while maintaining high edit consistency.

features.description: Discover the advanced capabilities of joymagic across various domains.

items.title: Photorealistic Generation
items.description: Delivers strong photorealistic image generation while maintaining excellent aesthetic quality.

items.title: Bilingual Text Rendering
items.description: Accurately renders complex Chinese and English text in various scenarios.

items.title: World Knowledge
items.description: Possesses vast understanding of world knowledge and diverse cultural concepts.

items.title: Semantic Understanding
items.description: Uses structured reasoning chain to inject logic and common sense.

items.title: Creative Editing
items.description: Precisely executes complex instructions for image transformations.

items.title: Instruction Following
items.description: Demonstrates fine-grained control over image elements and transformations.

models.title: Model Architecture
models.description: At just 6 billion parameters, the model produces photorealistic images on par with those from models an order of magnitude larger. It can run smoothly on consumer-grade graphics cards with less than 16GB of VRAM.

items.title: Single-Stream Diffusion
items.description: The joymagic model adopts a Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer architecture. This design unifies the processing of various conditional inputs (like text and image embeddings) with the noisy image latents into a single sequence, which is then fed into the Transformer backbone.

architecture.title: Technical Deep Dive
architecture.description: Learn about the innovative architecture and training techniques behind joymagic.

items.title: Decoupled-DMD
items.description: The core few-step distillation algorithm that empowers the 8-step joymagic model. By recognizing and decoupling CFG Augmentation and Distribution Matching, we developed an improved distillation process.

items.title: DMDR
items.description: Fusing DMD with Reinforcement Learning to achieve further improvements in semantic alignment, aesthetic quality, and structural coherence.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about joymagic and its capabilities.

items.question: What is joymagic?
items.answer: joymagic is an efficient 6-billion-parameter foundation model for image generation. It proves that top-tier performance is achievable without relying on enormous model sizes, delivering strong results in photorealistic generation and bilingual text rendering.

items.question: What are the main features of joymagic?
items.answer: joymagic excels in photorealistic image generation, bilingual text rendering (English & Chinese), ultra-fast inference (8 steps), efficient VRAM usage (16GB), rich world knowledge understanding, and creative image editing capabilities.

items.question: What models are available?
items.answer: joymagic oferece fluxos de trabalho otimizados para geração e edição de imagens, com saída de alta qualidade e seguimento confiável de instruções.

items.question: What hardware is required?
items.answer: joymagic can run smoothly on consumer-grade graphics cards with less than 16GB of VRAM. It achieves sub-second inference latency on enterprise-grade H800 GPUs.

items.question: Is joymagic open source?
items.answer: Yes! The model code, weights, and online demo are publicly available on GitHub, ModelScope, and HuggingFace to encourage community exploration and use.

items.question: What makes joymagic unique?
items.answer: joymagic adopts a Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer architecture that unifies conditional inputs with image latents. It uses innovative Decoupled-DMD distillation and DMDR reinforcement learning techniques for optimal performance.
